title: Role-Based Authorization
definition: Authorization happens *after* Authentication. While auth verifies WHO you are, authorization verifies WHAT you are allowed to do. Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) involves checking a user's role (admin, user, editor) before granting access to a specific route.
